selection_rule.pool: non-benchmark rows of the side-by-side table other than BASE (BASE is the comparator): DEF, CAP_DEF (W and M), CAND, CAND_CAP_DEF (W)
conditions_all_required: max_drawdown <= max_drawdown of BASE with the same cadence in ALL 6 cells (train and validation x trend 36/40/44)
T40 excess Sharpe strictly greater than 60_40 T-matched point estimate in BOTH train and validation
selection_rule.tie_rank: if more than 2 qualify, keep the two with the largest min(train xSharpe T40, validation xSharpe T40)
selection_rule.post_hoc_flag: CAND and CAND_CAP_DEF may qualify but are flagged post-hoc in the report
selection_rule.if_none_qualify: candidates_frozen.json lists no candidates; this is an acceptable outcome
selection_rule.freeze_rule: No further changes to any candidate; to be evaluated only on data after the freeze date.

candidates.cap_rule: at most 1 selected asset per group; walk the v2-ranked (momentum desc, universe tie-break) trend-passing assets in order and skip an asset whose group already has a selection

defensive_test.description: IEF adj_close total return from anchor session (latest session <= signal_close - DateOffset(months=3), as v2 find_anchor_session) to the signal close session, WITHOUT the one-week skip (window ends at signal close), strictly greater than the T-bill return over the same window (product of research_v3 CashYieldCurve.accrual_factor over consecutive sessions in (anchor, signal_close], each using the IRX value of the previous session or earlier). IEF if strictly greater, else CASH. Any missing input gives CASH.
